extracted.intended_audience: CIA Executive & Planning Division staff; internal CIA managers preparing management-effectiveness and cost-reduction submissions
extracted.subtask_description: An internal CIA memorandum listing Management Effectiveness and Cost Reduction goals to satisfy OMB Circular A-44 (Revised) reporting requirements for the last six months of fiscal year 1971; includes specific actions, expected savings/use of savings, and operational benefits. The page is a set of proposed operational changes intended to increase efficiency, security, and capacity without added manpower.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission of Management Effectiveness and Cost Reduction goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission called for the office's Management Effectiveness and Cost Reduction goals for the last six months of fiscal year 1971 for inclusion in the consolidated Office report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Forward these items to the consolidated Office report as requested in the memorandum dated 13 November 1970; differentiate items falling under Management Effectiveness vs Cost Reduction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost Reduction goals — indicate expected savings
rubrics_metrics.description: The savings expected to be realized by the Cost Reduction goals are to be specifically indicated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For any Cost Reduction proposal include an explicit estimate of expected dollar (or other measurable) savings so the consolidated report can account for quantifiable cost reductions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of savings from Management Effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Savings to be realized from Management Effectiveness goals will be applied to producing more units of work necessitated by a continuing heavy caseload without any increase in manpower.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not propose manpower increases; describe how efficiency gains will be redirected to increased output (more units of work) under existing staffing levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Convert Special Facilities Desk space into a vault area
rubrics_metrics.description: Convert the office space now occupied by the Special Facilities Desk, Special Activities Branch, OSD, into a vault area and dispose of five four-drawer safes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This change is intended to create a more efficient and more secure operation for this sensitive activity by centralizing secure storage and eliminating redundant safes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Convert manifold carbon form to NCR tablet form
rubrics_metrics.description: Convert an Agency form currently used as a manifold carbon form to NCR paper in tablet form for use by the Special Facilities Desk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The conversion is expected to save time (not yet quantifiable); time savings should be applied to increased production of work units.

rubrics_metrics.name: Replace separate desks and safes with desks having two-drawer safe cabinets
rubrics_metrics.description: Procure four desks equipped with two-drawer safe cabinets in exchange for separate desks and safes used by Support Branch/OSD to maximize utilization of a confined area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The exchange should facilitate more orderly storage for classified material, improve administrative control, and free space for an additional Branch supervisor urgently needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve remote access to security files (secure telecon system)
rubrics_metrics.description: Initiate a more readily accessible means to obtain necessary information from security files, especially for Operational Support Division components physically separated from Headquarters; one option is a secure telecon system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide separated components immediate access to pertinent file information to increase efficiency and expedite handling of sensitive assignments; ensure secure communications for classified material.
